source_title: Speedy Hire Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 48, 99, 103 and 135 state that the strategic report or financial statements were approved by the Board on 14 May 2019; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue excluding disposals increased 6.0% to £389.2m, EBITDA rose 7.8% to £78.7m, adjusted profit before tax increased 19.3% to £30.9m and statutory profit before tax increased 51.1% to £27.2m. Gross margin was broadly flat at 57.1%. Free cash flow moved to a £9.8m outflow after £30.9m acquisition spend, and net debt increased to £89.4m, but leverage remained low at 1.1x with £68.4m facility headroom. Cost-base restructuring included depot closures or repurposing, redundancies and £1.2m annual savings.
already_announced_exclusion: The disclosed efficiency and restructuring programmes, depot closures or repurposing, redundancies, fleet rationalisation, acquisitions and associated cost savings were announced or completed before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Explicit cost-base action and acquisition-led cash outflow create contained pressure, but strong revenue, EBITDA and profit growth, stable margin, low leverage, ample headroom and a higher dividend provide exceptionally strong contrary evidence.
